results: Fresh search found standards, integrators and comparison content, but no clear direct software matching the vendor-claim evidence matrix workflow.
Robot Safety Center, OnPath Robotics and RoboCred cover task risk, controls, validation and compliance evidence for robots/machinery.
Reglyr, Kallik, Esko/WebCenter and Loftware directly cover regulatory label change, affected SKUs, artwork approval and auditability.
Rotion, MoreeOS, Cirqle, Utz ID and Cyclebox cover reusable packaging identification, circulation, wash/inspection or lifecycle tracking.
AuraVMS is a near/direct capital-equipment RFQ comparison workflow; fresh search did not establish more than one direct food-processing-specific evidence workspace.
